name: Chris's Classroom
storyline: Chris's Classroom takes place in an unknown location roamed by Chris and his friends. The protagonist (who we will call the player) decides to go to this location on a mission to gather information regarding the place, unaware that they would stumble into Chris, their old lecturer. The player was initially given the goal of completing projects, but soon after, their directive shifted into collecting Chris's Stress Toys, ultimately infuriating Chris. Overtime, the player encounters Chris's friends, who were sent by Chris to stop the player. As the player collects more Stress Toys, Chris increasingly gets more mad, until the player steals the final Stress Toy, sending Chris into a blind rage, and shifting the environment, giving the player little time to escape. Soon after, the player manages to escape, leaving Chris and his friends. What happened to Chris and his friends has yet to be seen.
summary: Chris's Classroom is a comedic indie horror game where players must collect Stress Toys while avoiding Chris and his friends.
